verdict.rationale: Low-level engine tuning is a fair question for a local model-serving runtime like LocalAI, so the axis applies. However, nothing in the evidence documents overriding memory locking, mmap, or similar engine settings. The cited advanced options (external gRPC backends, model preloading) and automatic GPU backend detection are adjacent features, not the requested overrides.

support.subject: As a power-user, I can override low-level engine settings like memory locking or mmap behavior instead of being limited to opinionated defaults
